[b]Formation of the NDF[/b]

Piracy, smuggling, fighting, and war is on the rise. Protecting each other is crucial, and east shamat is no different.

The Maritime Defence Force is starting to Invest in a new Formation of a Inter-National Coalition, the Naval Defence Force. They will patrol the Sea and the East-Shamat Strait, and also protect each others nation, and potentially attack enemies.

Tartakum Is inviting Nations located in the Area to Participate. The Tartees Navy will be Pulling its fleet from homeland defence and moving it towards the Defence. They will be resting the First fleet, in charge of protecting the straight in the east shamat sea. In this fleet will be

2x of the Nordihiem produced naval ships
2x Osa class frigates
1x Kirov Class

Tartakum will be acquiring more naval ships. Tartakum is also requesting natiomns to sign up. Any nation may join an active fleet.
